component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.assets.share.directories
component.documentation: Where share links and their downloads are kept: two directories on the server's default directory template, as Nuxeo keeps its authentication tokens (authTokens) and its permissions' notes (aceinfo). Of the system type, which the REST API's directory listing leaves out, and readable by the group __Nobody__ only, so by nobody but an administrator and server code run with the system's rights. No cache: every read is of the database, so a revocation holds from the next request on. No field holds a token: a link's id is its token's SHA-256.
